name: Hannan Shakib LMS Student Teacher Portal for Elementor
author: hannanshakib

sections.description:
Hannan Shakib LMS Student Teacher Portal for Elementor is an advanced, fully-featured management tool creating a robust separation between “Students” and “Teachers”, allowing for controlled distribution of Class Materials, Notices, and secure document viewing.

Designed exclusively for Elementor, it provides a seamless front-end tabbed dashboard with extensive styling options.

Features & Options

  • Elementor Integration: Includes the “HS Dynamic Student Dashboard” widget with complete styling controls (Typography, Colors, Backgrounds, Borders, Hover Effects).
  • Role-Based Access Control: Separate registration and login workflows for Students and Teachers.
  • Admin Approval System: All new registrations are held in a “Pending Approval” state until an administrator approves them from the WordPress backend.
  • Secure Document Vault (PDF.js): Class materials open in a secure, custom-built modal viewer. Downloading, right-clicking, and printing (Ctrl+P) are strictly disabled to protect intellectual property.
  • Teacher Backend Isolation: Teachers have restricted access to the WordPress admin. They can only see and manage their own uploaded media and materials.
  • Notice Board: Publicly downloadable notices and general announcements.
  • Dynamic Read Receipts: Unread notices and materials are flagged with “New” badges on the student’s dashboard.
  • Profile Management: Students and teachers can view their profile details and change their account passwords directly from the front-end dashboard.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to your /wp-content/plugins/hannan-shakib-lms-student-teacher-portal-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Create or edit a page with Elementor.
  5. Drag the “HS Dynamic Student Dashboard” widget onto the canvas.
  6. Configure the styling options in the Elementor panel.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require Elementor?

Yes, Elementor is strictly required to use the frontend dashboard widget.

How do I approve a user’s registration?

Once a user registers, check the “Students” or “Teachers” tab in your WordPress admin. Look for the red “Pending Approval” tag and click the “Approve” button to grant them access.

Are the Class Materials secure?

Yes. The plugin uses advanced Canvas rendering via PDF.js to prevent unauthorized downloading, text selection, and printing.

How do I assign materials to specific students?

When creating a new “Notice & Material” post, you can use the multi-select search box to assign the material exclusively to specific approved students.
